final_name.description: From Strawberry, head to Owanjia Dam, there's usually a beaver by the water as you approach. Then just keep going around the shoreline for more. Change lobbies to get more spawns. They're timid, so Blending Tonics are useful. Varmint Rifle and a head shot for clean kills.

final_name.description: Deer are fairly common over most of New Hanover, West Elizabeth and Lemoyne. Scarlett Meadows, Big Valley and to the East of Emerald station are all good spots too. Please note that Pronghorns do not count. It has to be Whitetails. A Whitetail Buck will count though.

At Colter in an empty lobby you'll often rescue a woman who needs to go to Adler Ranch.
Just above the 'S' in Saint Denis is often the start of a rescue mission, as is just below the 'D' in Denis.
On the road out of Blackwater before Quakers Cove there's often a woman offering a rescue.

final_name.text: Jumped onto a horse from a 3m height
final_name.description: Go to Blackwater and climb the first ladder at the back of the musical theatre, then jump on to your horse below. [#1]
all_descriptions: Go to Blackwater and climb the first ladder at the back of the musical theatre, then jump on to your horse below. [#1]
Climb on to the stable roof at Tumbleweed. You need to just get on to the highest section of the roof before you jump, but don't go all the way to the top. [#2]
Go to Rathskeller Fork, north of Tumbleweed. Jump off from the apex off the barn roof to complete. [#3]

final_name.text: 3 Player kills with melee in Showdowns
final_name.description: If you have a willing friend, an Elimination Showdown is a good bet, you can just rugby tackle and subdue them. Otherwise this can be very tough.
all_descriptions: If you have a willing friend, an Elimination Showdown is a good bet, you can just rugby tackle and subdue them. Otherwise this can be very tough.

final_name.description: Head west out of MacFarlane's Ranch, and keep going west along the road with Pike's Basin on the right. There's often an ambush there when in a solo lobby. [#2]
all_descriptions: The road through Black Bone Forest, at the western side of Big Valley is usually a pretty reliable ambush. Much more likely in a solo lobby though. [#1]
Head west out of MacFarlane's Ranch, and keep going west along the road with Pike's Basin on the right. There's often an ambush there when in a solo lobby. [#2]
The loop of roads beside the Dakota River as it travels below Painted Sky near Valentine has a number of ambush spots. Try a solo lobby. [#3]
Go to Lagras, head south, then turn west past Hagen Orchards towards the lake that looks like a boot at Bayall Edge. That road west of the lake often has an ambush. Solo lobby works best. [#4]

Head to Wapiti, then set a marker for 'Chez Porter' just west of Whinyard Strait. Stay there for a moment or two, and then head back to Wapiti, there's often an ambush as you cross the wooden bridge. [#5]
